reviews.title: Charged for subscription after removing my profile and deleting the app.
reviews.contents: I did not agree to any subscriptions, I just wanted to look at the APP. It wasn’t for us and I decided to delete it after signing myself out, and removing from my phone, now I am seeing a charge of 41.99 on my bank statements for my debit card?!?! I don’t even have the app on my phone anymore. Please help me rectify this as I am contacting Apple Pay and trying to tell them I haven’t even re downloaded the app or signed back in to use what I’ve been charge for.

reviews.title: Not a fan of the visual updates
reviews.contents: Updated visuals is unnecessarily distracting.  I paid for my membership because I really enjoyed the low stimulating, calm and yet cute tracking system.  I just wanted to track my baby, but now I can’t open the app without my baby interested on what’s on the screen. And with all the extra animations it takes way too long to just get in, click start timer, and close.  Too many bright colours and characters.  Please bring back the option to have the old, calmer set up.
